admission.authentic: Credible provenance of the physical watch or examination by a qualified verifier who is independent of this repository's folder names and of any model.
admission.counterfeit: Affirmative evidence from a qualified independent verifier or an institutional record that the item is counterfeit. Visual suspicion is not enough.
admission.image_rights: A recorded license or owner permission that allows research use. Rights are recorded separately from the authenticity label.
admission.insufficient_label_evidence: Do not admit. Use REJECTED or REQUIRES_EXPERT_REVIEW.

decision_rule.CONDITIONAL_GO: A named source has documented label methodology and a concrete outstanding permission or data commitment. Admitted counts may be below the target.
decision_rule.GO: At least 30 admitted authentic and 30 admitted counterfeit images, at least three brands, at least two source groups, and every admitted row has both a research-use right and complete independent label evidence. A count by itself is not enough.
decision_rule.NO_GO: No admitted image meets the evidence rule, and no named source has a concrete outstanding commitment.

compare_against: Phase 35 and Phase 36 manifests by recorded path or hash

purpose: Decide whether a small legally usable set of independently verified authentic and counterfeit watch images can be acquired. This phase does not train or score a model.
search_scope: Re-read Phase 46 data_audit.json and apply this protocol's admission rule. Do not treat the earlier rejection text as a new label.
Search public dataset documentation for watch authenticity ground truth with a stated image license.
Record whether any qualified-watchmaker, dealer, or owner-permission agreement exists in this repository.
